name: Good Cop Bad Cop
summary: Hidden-team deduction game where cops hunt the opposing secret leader, Agent vs Kingpin, using bluff and investigation.
rules_text: Each player gets 3 Integrity cards face-down (1 of which is secretly Agent or Kingpin in the mix). Majority Honest = Honest team unless you hold Kingpin; majority Crooked = Crooked unless you hold Agent. Agent is Honest leader, Kingpin is Crooked leader. Also get 1 secret Equipment card, guns in center. On your turn do one: Investigate (peek at one face-down Integrity anywhere and replace), Equip (draw Equipment and flip one of your Integrity face-up if any), Arm (take a gun from center and flip one Integrity face-up), or Shoot your held gun at aimed player and return gun. After action if you hold a gun you must aim at someone else and announce it. Equipment can be used any time to interfere. If shot, reveal all Integrity; if not Leader you are eliminated; Leader takes a Wounded token and draws Equipment, second shot eliminates. Honest wins if Kingpin eliminated, Crooked wins if Agent eliminated, solo win if one player holds both Leader cards.
